verdict.rationale: BILL's developer site explicitly points AI agents to an llms.txt docs index and lets them append .md to any docs page for a markdown version. A probe confirmed llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with structured content, and a dedicated AI agent resources page offers a documentation MCP server for Cursor, Windsurf and Claude Desktop. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using these docs effectively, and evidence of how far the llms.txt index covers the S&E-specific docs.
